_comment: Craftsman for GitHub Copilot CLI and cloud agent: copy to .github/hooks/craftsman.json (the only location the cloud agent loads) and set CRAFTSMAN_ROOT to where this plugin is checked out (the cloud job clones the repository, so a vendored copy or a checkout step is needed). PascalCase form, so matchers map create to Write and edit/str_replace_editor to Edit. timeoutSec stays far above the gates' measured latency because a hook timeout is documented as fail-open on every event, preToolUse included. Documented contract, not yet captured from a Copilot consumer (tests/fixtures/hosts/copilot/documented).
